Description (in game): The effects of Singing abilities last a turn longer.
When a Singing ability is performed, there is a 25% chance that an additional Singing ability will be triggered.
Notes: Affected by Luck. If you have Across the Board active, single target songs will be used AoE.

Description (in game): Increase all allies' physical and magical attack for three turns.
Notes: Condition: Use Singing x12. Aim+15%. Grants +30-60% P.Atk and M.Atk, scaling linearly with job level.

Description (in game): Reduce physical damage to multiple targets by 15% for three turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Notes: ON SWITCH: In spite of the claim the min is 65% (-35%), appears to actually cap at -80% damage taken (the additive damage reduction cap). Min displayed multiplier is 65%.

Description (in game): Reduce magical damage to multiple targets by 15% for three turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Notes: ON SWITCH: In spite of the claim the min is 65% (-35%), appears to actually cap at -80% damage taken (the additive damage reduction cap). Min displayed multiplier is 65%.

Description (in game): Increase the likelihood of a target being the subject of enemy attacks by 20% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Attempt to put a target to sleep.
The effects of Singing and Artistry abilities are increased by a percentage based on the user's level divided by fifteen.
Notes: Rounds to nearest whole number % increase. i.e. Lvl 1-7: +0%, Lvl 8-22: +1%, Lvl 23-37: +2%, Lvl 38-52: +3%, Lvl 53-67: +4%, Lvl 68-82: +5%, Lvl 83-97: +6%. Lvl 98-99: +7%. Only affects the % based buffs and debuffs, does not affect damage dealing moves.

Description (in game): Increase multiple targets' aim by 5% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Increase multiple targets' evasion by 5% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Increase physical damage inflicted by multiple targets by 15% for two turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Notes: ON SWITCH: In spite of the claim the max is 200% (+100%), appears to have no actual cap on multiplier. Max displayed multiplier is 200%.

Description (in game): Increase magical damage inflicted by multiple targets by 15% for two turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Notes: ON SWITCH: In spite of the claim the max is 200% (+100%), appears to have no actual cap on multiplier. Max displayed multiplier is 200%.

Description (in game): Increase multiple targets' critical chance by 15% for two turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Perform an extremely powerful non-elemental magic attack on multiple targets.
Notes: Is not considered magic damage for the purpose of skills like Magic Amp and Reflect.

Description (in game): Cause a target to act immediately after the user.
Notes: When used multiple times in a turn, all targets become ready to act immediately and will act in a (seemingly) random order. Cannot be group cast even with Across the Board. Seems to be rarely used by Encore (with a random target)

Description (in game): Perform a powerful non-elemental magic attack on all targets that may also put them to sleep.
Notes: Is not considered magic damage for the purpose of skills like Magic Amp and Reflect.

Description (in game): Targeting all enemies with spells or abilities will not reduce their damage or effects.
Notes: Affects AoE specials as well as attacks and heals.

Description (in game): Extend the effects of all Singing abilities currently affecting all targets for another three turns.
Notes: Not affected directly by Extended Outro (it still gives +3 turns, not +4).

Description (in game): When an attack on the user reduces their HP to 20% or lower, a random captured monster will be let loose on the enemy.
Notes: Targets whoever reduced HP below 20%. Does not trigger from attacking self but does trigger when attacked by an ally, in which case ally will be attacked. Does not consume a use of rescue animal summoned.

Description (in game): All stats are increased by an amount based on the number of monsters you've captured.
Notes: Each creature captured gives: 5 HP, 1 MP, 0.4 P.Atk, 0.4 P.Def, 0.4 M.Atk, 0.4 M.Def, 0.2 Res. Power, 0.02 Speed, 0.02 Aim, 0.02 Evasion, 0.04 Crit. Bonus applies after all stat multipliers including weight penalties.

Description (in game): Strike all enemies with a powerful physical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Taming x13. P.Atk+15%, M.Atk+15%.

Description (in game): Capture a weakened monster. Chance of success is based on the target's remaining HP–the lower the better. Will not work on humans or more powerful enemies.
Notes:
Affected by Luck. Guidebook gives a formula but it's unclear (see comment for formula as written). Cleaned up it is probably meant to be:
Chance to capture (%) = 40 x (Max HP - Current HP) / Max HP + min((10 - Current HP) x 10,0), i.e. capture chance varies linearly from 0 to 40% as enemy HP drops, but once enemy HP drops below 10 the chance quickly spikes up to 100%.

Description (in game): Let a captured monster loose on a target.
Notes: All beasts (that I've seen) operate independently of character stats and buffs. See Readme for a link to a Captures guide

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target and significantly delay their next action.
Notes: Increases target action cooldown by 70

Description (in game): Attempt to silence multiple targets.
Perform a physical attack on all targets.
Perform a physical attack on a target. This attack cannot reduce HP below one.
Every use of the Brave command increases physical attack by 10% until the end of the turn.
Notes: Direct P.Atk buff, capped at 999. Additive with any other P.Atk buffs including in battle ones

Description (in game): The user will act first in battle when a spear is equipped, unless the enemy has the advantage.
Notes: If used by multiple characters, all will start with turn order bar filled, and who goes first will be random.

Description (in game): Perform a powerful physical attack on a target. This attack cannot reduce HP below one.
Reduces MP consumption by 20%.
Notes: Additive with other MP cost reduction sources

Description (in game): Roughly 30% chance of capturing defeated monsters.
Notes: Affected by luck

Description (in game): Send a captured monster to brutally savage a target.
Notes: Appears to do 3x the damage of Off the Leash. All beasts (that I've seen) operate independently of character stats and buffs. See Readme for a link to a Captures guide

Description (in game): Use equipped spear to perform four powerful physical attacks at random. These attacks may also silence their targets.
Notes: Must have a spear equipped to use this, however your full P.Atk is applied as usual (i.e. other weapons aren't ignored). Damage is not reduced against groups.

Description (in game): Increases physical attack by 50% when three BP are spent performing the Brave command in the same turn.
Notes: Direct P.Atk buff, capped at 999. Additive with any other P.Atk buffs including in battle ones

Description (in game): Reduce the user's MP costs to zero for two turns.
Notes: Applies only to ability costs. Passive MP costs such as through Results Guaranteed are still paid. When combined with Up to No Good, both abilities apply, making any BP cost abilities cost 0 MP instead.

Description (in game): Gives 'Steal X' abilities the additional bonus of being able to take a single strengthening effect from an enemy and apply it to the user.
Notes: Steals a single stack of a single buff. Triggers on Steal Breath, Steal Spirit and Steal Courage (not from "Steal"). Triggers even if the attack misses or cannot steal anything.

Description (in game): Defaulting no longer causes BP to increase, but all abilities that are usually performed using BP can be performed using MP, and the cost of 'Steal X' abilities is halved.
Notes: Every 1 BP of cost becomes 40 MP. BP cost reduction abilities apply first, then any MP cost reductions also apply. MP cost reduction to Steal X abilities is additive with other MP cost reduction sources.

Description (in game): Strike a single enemy with a powerful physical attack that is guaranteed to steal an item.
Notes: Condition: Use Thievery x13. P.Atk+15%, Spd+15%. As long as the foe has stealable items, this will steal something.

Description (in game): Attempt to steal an item from an enemy.
Notes: Affected by luck, but not affected by Results Guaranteed. Steal chance seems dependent on enemies primarily.

Description (in game): Perform a quick physical attack on a target that also heals the user.
Notes: Health healed is equal to damage dealt. Damage dealt is limited to enemies remaining HP. Hurts you when attacking undead enemies.

Description (in game): Escape from battle without fail. Won't work in certain encounters.
Reduce a target's MP and restore MP to the user.
Notes: Deals MP damage. MP is healed equal to three times damage dealt. Damage dealt is limited to enemies remaining MP. Hurts you when attacking undead enemies. Capped at 100 MP damage, but random damage range applies after this.

Description (in game): Perform a wind-imbued physical attack on a target.
Attempt to steal one BP from a target. This ability has a roughly 50% chance of success. BP cannot be stolen from targets who have 0 or fewer BP.
Notes: You lose BP when attacking undead enemies.

Description (in game): Damage inflicted by items is increased by 50%.
Notes: Does not affect Salve Maker attack items. Additive with other damage increases, e.g. Work your Magic.

Description (in game): The user occasionally steals items when performing regular attacks.
Notes: Chance of activating is affected by luck.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target with an attack power bonus based on the user's speed. Further damage will also be inflicted after a little time has passed.
Notes: Adds (Speed x 1.5) to Attack in damage formula (approximately 16.4 damage per point of speed). Both hits deal identical damage, first hit must land for second hit to trigger. Yes, this attack is completely broken.

Description (in game): Roughly 25% chance of acquiring rare items when stealing.
Notes: Affected by luck. Each enemy has a rare steal as well as a common steal, without this skill you cannot access the rare steal at all.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective on sleeping targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking sleeping foes (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): When stealing, two items can be acquired at once.
Notes: Stacks additively if multiple copies (from Givampalui) are equipped.

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful wind-imbued physical attack on a target.
Dagger aptitude is increased to S.
Attacking sleeping enemies will not wake them up.
Experience, JP or pg earned after battle will drop to zero, but one of these three amounts will also very occasionally be multiplied by 15.
Notes: Odds of activating the x15 bonus is apparently 6%. Does not appear to be affected by luck. x15 bonus appears to be additive with other sources of extra pg

Description (in game): Increases the number of winning slots in roulette abilities. Abilities with a chance of triggering extra effects are also more likely to do so.
Notes: Increases luck by 10%. On roulette abilities, replace the worst available slot with the best possible slot (usually replacing 10>1 or 1>10 in ties)

Description (in game): Completely restore all allies' MP and earn some pg into the bargain.
Notes: Condition: Use Gaming x10. Crit +30%. Earns 777 pg at level 1, earns 11,111 pg at level 15, scaling linearly in between. Not affected by skills or Golden Egg.

Description (in game): Spin the wheel and perform a physical attack on a target that can deal double damage depending on whether the result is odd or even.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 3x when landing on correct number. Average damage ratio is therefore 2.25x, rising to 2.4x with Born Lucky

Description (in game): Spin the wheel to revive unconscious allies and restore their HP. The amount of HP restored depends on the result of the wheel, but stopping on a skull will KO the user.
Notes: Revives with (100 x Roll) HP. Replaces 1, 4 & 9 with a skull (with Born Lucky, the 1 is replaced with a 10 instead), causing instant death on the user. This can be prevented with Instant Death immunity

Description (in game): Spend 50 pg multiplied by the user's level to deal 1.3x that amount of damage to a target.
Notes: Damage pierces defence, damage is fixed.

Description (in game): Pg earned after battle increases by 10% for every party member with this ability.
Notes: Additive with itself and other money bonuses such as Golden Egg.

Description (in game): Spin the wheel and receive 77 times the result in pg.
Spin a double wheel featuring both numbers and elements, and perform elemental attacks on random targets based on the result.
Notes: Is not considered magic for the purpose of skills. 2nd element wheel contains one of each element, plus non-elemental. Average total damage multiplier is 4.95x, rising to 5.76x with Born Lucky

Description (in game): Spin the wheel and perform a physical attack on a target. Landing on a number in the range selected will result in triple damage.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 4.5x when landing on correct number. Average damage ratio is therefore 2.4x, rising to 2.7x with Born Lucky

Description (in game): Non-roulette abilities with a chance of triggering extra effects are more likely to do so at night.
Notes: Increases luck at night by 20%

Description (in game): Spin a wheel featuring the numbers one to ten. Landing on ten will result in all allies or enemies earning three BP.
Notes: Description is rather poor. Targets only all allies or all enemies and will only affect that side. If successful, everyone's BP is set to exactly +3. This can lower it from +4 if you have BP Limit Up.

Description (in game): The likelihood of enemies dropping rare items increases by 10% for every party member with this ability.
Notes: This appears to lower the chance of getting common item drops. Beware of this if the items you want from an enemy are their common drop (most common in the Hall fights)

Description (in game): Spend 10000 pg to perform an extremely powerful physical attack on a target.
Trigger random effects that can affect enemies, allies or both.
Notes: Wide variety of helpful and harmful effects. I'm not going to document them.

Description (in game): Pg earned after battle increases by 20% for every party member with this ability.
Notes: Additive with itself and other money bonuses such as Golden Egg.

Description (in game): Spin a double wheel featuring both numbers and elements, and perform powerful elemental attacks on random targets based on the result.
Notes: Is not considered magic for the purpose of skills. 2nd element wheel contains one of each element, plus non-elemental. Average total damage multiplier is 11x, rising to 12.8x with Born Lucky

Description (in game): Spin the wheel and perform a physical attack that will be eight times more powerful if you land on number eight.
Notes: Wheel is replaced with two 8s, eight 1s (three 8s, seven 1s with Born Lucky). Damage ratio becomes 16x when landing on 8. Average damage ratio is therefore 4.6x, rising to 6.2x with Born Lucky

Description (in game): Attacking a Defaulting target will no longer result in reduced damage.
Actions can be chosen freely half the time while berserk.
Notes: Affected by luck

Description (in game): Strike all enemies with a powerful physical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Savagery x13. P.Def +15%, Aim +15%.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on all targets.
Go berserk for the next three turns. (While berserk, physical attack is increased by 50%, physical defence is reduced by 30%, and only the 'Attack' command can be used.)
Perform a powerful physical attack on a target.
Notes: What is being doubled here? 🤔

Description (in game): Perform a water-imbued physical attack on a target.
Physical attacks performed by the user cannot be evaded, but will also damage them. However, this damage cannot reduce their HP below one.
Notes: Damage taken = 20% of damage dealt, or reducing you to 1 HP, whichever is less. Has priority over forced evasion, and guarantees Strong Strike hits.

Description (in game): The attacking abilities performed at random while berserk do not cost anything.
Notes: Ability description is bad. While Berserk, random attacking abilities (magic or physical) will be used. These cost nothing. When combined with Rage and Reason, any abilities (including non-attacks) can be used at 0 cost.

Description (in game): Perform a quick physical attack on a target that will reduce their physical defence by 5% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Perform a quick physical attack on a target that will reduce their magical defence by 5% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Prevents all status ailments that impede the user's ability to freely choose their actions. (Sleep, paralysis, dread, berserk, confusion, charm and freezing.)
Notes: Also prevents Stop

Description (in game): Perform a powerful physical attack on all targets.
Allows regular attacks to target all enemies at full power, but causes the user's next turn to come around much later.
Notes: Effects regular attacks only. Adds 400 to their action cost, after weight effects are applied (if you are sufficiently light this means 650 action cost instead of 250 for basic attacks)

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful physical attack on a target.
Perform a powerful water-imbued physical attack on a target.
Axe aptitude is increased to S.
Perform an incredibly powerful physical attack on all targets. The lower the user's current HP, the greater the damage inflicted.
Notes: Damage ratio is 9 + 10 x (max HP - Current HP) / Max HP, i.e. damage ratio is 9 at full health, rising linearly to ~19 at 1 HP.
